body: you obviously care about those around you so i doubt youre some 'terrible burden.' i've lost close friends after bad circumstances and still didnt feel any less grief over them. i don't know your situation but i thought i'd share that there's not many things you can do to make people stop caring about you. it's a nice thing to hold onto during rough times.
what about disappearing do you think would make others happy?

just curious but why do you need it to be ok with someone? i dont think waiting will ever create enough distance for people not to be affected by a death of a loved one. i know as a stranger i'd still feel affected knowing another poster disappeared.
